experiment_name: Held-Out Attack Family / Novel Behavior Evaluation
leakage_controls: Attack family 'EXFILTRATION' strictly held out from classifier training (0 samples in train).
FeatureScaler fitted strictly on known training data.
Autoencoder novelty detector trained strictly on benign baseline.
Threshold calibrated strictly on unseen benign validation windows.
interpretation: When presented with held-out 'EXFILTRATION' telemetry, the Known Attack Classifier exhibits uncertain known-class confidence, while the Layer 2 Novelty Detector achieves 100.0% anomaly detection rate (AUROC=1.0000). The dynamic Risk Engine escalates risk (mean=77.4/100) and flags the event as 'Potential Novel Behavior', preserving human-in-the-loop validation without guessing attack types.
